videos.title: Three Wisest Men
videos.description: As life pushes their family in different directions, the Brenner boys decide they need to put on the best Christmas ever to bring everyone back together.

videos.title: In Merry Measure
videos.description: When pop star Darcy returns home to spend Christmas with her sister and niece, she unexpectedly finds herself coaching the high school choir with her onetime rival, Adam.

videos.title: Heart of the Holidays
videos.description: Career-driven Sam returns to her hometown for the holidays, where she comes face-to-face with her high school boyfriend, Noah. Together, they rediscover what matters most in life.

videos.title: A Christmas Cookie Catastrophe
videos.description: Sparks fly between the new CEO of a small-town cookie company and the owner of a local bakery as they try to recreate a stolen secret recipe.

videos.title: Jingle Bell Run
videos.description: Self-described bookworm Avery is paired with retired hockey star Wes to compete in a holiday race across America. The team struggles through themed challenges until romance runs its course.

videos.title: A Bride for Christmas
videos.description: Aiden (Andrew Walker) bets his friends that he can convince a woman to marry him by Christmas, and he sets his sights on Jessie (Arielle Kebbel), a young woman who has sworn off serious relationships.

videos.title: Christmas on My Mind
videos.description: Lucy Lovett wakes up holding a wedding dress and assumes she is about to marry the love her life, Zach Callahan.

videos.title: A Maple Valley Christmas
videos.description: Erica is a rancher who's spent her whole life working the family farm with her mother and sister. When Aaron arrives and disrupts her plans, she starts to question what it is she actually wants.

videos.title: Our Holiday Playbook
videos.description: To help her father win their annual flag football game, Lexi convinces Eddie to join the team as her pretend boyfriend in exchange for coaching him through his family baking contest.

videos.title: Three Wise Men and a Baby
videos.description: Three brothers get the surprise of their lives when they are forced to work together and care for a baby over the holidays.

videos.title: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley
videos.description: Fleeing Hollywood, on-set vet Goldie intends to own the beloved animal clinic in Blue Dog Valley. She strives to earn the town's trust — especially with the help of Cohen, the previous vet's son.

videos.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
videos.description: After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas bar following his passing, she competes against its neighboring competitor, and its manager Zach, to help save it from its drowning debt.

videos.title: Christmas Wishes & Mistletoe Kisses
videos.description: Weeks before Christmas, an interior designer is hired to decorate the estate of a wealthy businessman.

videos.title: Time for You to Come Home for Christmas
videos.description: Katherine returns home after her husband passes and meets a veteran who is on his holiday journey. As Christmas nears, they learn of a bond that may be the miracle they need.

videos.title: The Mistletoe Promise
videos.description: Two strangers with a disdain for Christmas make a holiday pact to pretend to be a couple to ease their holiday complications. As they spend more time together, the phony couple begin to experience the magic of Christmas.

videos.title: Christmas Waltz
videos.description: A woman makes an unexpected connection with her dance instructor after her storybook Christmas wedding is canceled.

videos.title: Project Christmas Wish
videos.description: A woman's life becomes transformed as she works toward granting a little girl's wish for a Christmas like she used to have with her mother.

videos.title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
videos.description: When organized caterer Lexi and chill snowboarder Ridge notice a spark between their single parents, they begrudgingly team up to set them up.

videos.title: The Christmas Secret
videos.description: A struggling single mother (Bethany Joy Lenz) searches for a lost family heirloom that she hopes will bring her love and good fortune in time for the holidays.

videos.title: My Christmas Cowboy
videos.description: Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, the pair reunite in the small Texas town of Fern where they must team up to save the town's Christmas Roundup.

videos.title: A Royal Queens Christmas
videos.description: A prince makes his way to Queens, N.Y., when a local woman enlists his help for a children's Christmas show.

videos.title: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley
videos.description: Fleeing Hollywood, on-set vet Goldie intends to own the beloved animal clinic in Blue Dog Valley. She strives to earn the town's trust — especially with the help of Cohen, the previous vet's son.

videos.title: Double Booked for the Holidays
videos.description: Twins Abigail and Charlie spend Christmas in Wales to run a bookstore and get swept into holiday romances with two Hay-on-Wye locals, a charming barista and a dashing lord.

videos.title: A Christmas Carousel
videos.description: Lila is hired by the royal family of Ancadia to repair a carousel and must work with the prince to complete it by Christmas.

videos.title: A Little Christmas Charm
videos.description: A jewelry designer teams up with an investigative reporter to find the owner of a charm bracelet before Christmas Eve.

videos.title: Next Stop, Christmas
videos.description: Angie wonders what life would be like if she had married an ex who became famous. When she finds herself magically transported into the past, Angie has the chance to relive that Christmas and learn what (and who) is truly important to her.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Christmas!
videos.description: A woman signs on to be a costume designer for a movie that's shooting in her hometown. While rediscovering her passion for the craft, she winds up falling for the film's famous leading man.

videos.title: The Secret Gift of Christmas
videos.description: A personal shopper helps her new client and recent widower reconnect with his young daughter, find them both everything on their wish list, and rediscover the joys of Christmas.

videos.title: Christmas in Rome
videos.description: Angela, an American tour guide in Rome, agrees to teach a culture-shocked businessman named Oliver about the heart of Rome at Christmas.

videos.title: Snow Bride
videos.description: A tabloid reporter races to find juicy gossip on a prominent political family. She ends up spending the week before Christmas with the family and falls for one of their sons.

videos.title: Who's Coming for Christmas?
videos.description: Inspired by her late grandmother, Julie plans Christmas Eve dinner in her new home, without a guest list, and has faith that the eight seats around her table will be filled by friends and neighbors.

videos.title: Never Kiss a Man in a Christmas Sweater
videos.description: A single mom faces Christmas alone until a stranger crashes into her life and becomes an unexpected houseguest.

videos.title: Melt My Heart This Christmas
videos.description: Holly, a passionate glassblower, secretly displays her own art under a pseudonym while assisting a legendary glassblower to help Jack at a Christmas Fair.

videos.title: Double Booked for the Holidays
videos.description: Twins Abigail and Charlie spend Christmas in Wales to run a bookstore and get swept into holiday romances with two Hay-on-Wye locals, a charming barista and a dashing lord.

videos.title: A Merry Scottish Christmas
videos.description: When estranged siblings Lindsay and Brad Morgan travel to Scotland at Christmas to reunite with their mother Jo, a big family secret is revealed.

videos.title: Pride, Prejudice and Mistletoe
videos.description: When Darcy returns to her hometown for Christmas, and she reconnects with Luke, a former rival, they must plan a charity event together. As she spends time with her family and Luke, she starts to realize what matters most in life.

videos.title: Believe in Christmas
videos.description: With no other plans for Christmas, best friends Bea and Emilia travel to Christmasland, a magical place filled with hope, holiday miracles and romance.
